authority: Finite consumer scope for one small public wallet.
task: Use the Portfolio UI with native stake enabled for the selected wallet. Prepare the bounded launcher profile with local synthetic proof, then perform at most three upstream GETs.
preconditions: Bind the launcher to the exact built artifact; run the synthetic allowlist and count proof before any live access.
Use only the server-side DMND credential; no credentials or provider URLs are exposed to the browser.
The API and worker identities must still match the qualified readiness record; otherwise refuse before any read.
No implicit tabs, hooks, strict-mode retries or reloads may expand the three-GET ceiling; reuse captured data for screenshots.
Do not borrow or reset another scope's ledger.

producer_evidence.scope: Prior two-wallet complete-empty stake qualification; not a positive-holding proof

required_outcome: Report the actual HTTP status, body, coverage, clocks and amounts. A due scan may be queued, stale or partial on first read; preserve that state and do not infer a complete portfolio. Empty accounts are a supported-scope empty only if fresh and complete at the returned slot.
provider_runtime_boundary: Readiness checks made no wallet or provider calls and no mutations. Ordinary consumer reads may trigger already-enabled snapshot and stake acquisition under the service's existing limits.
